title: Base legacy disposition and transition on structured assessment
requirements:
- Make integration conditional on assessment of safety, data quality, security, supportability and cost, not age alone
- Include contracts, data, workforce and paper or hybrid workflows in the legacy baseline
- Require transition planning well before contract end (migration, testing, parallel running, cutover)
- Qualify the position against blank-slate approaches
- Note that standards-based systems can still form silos and require shared governance, stewardship and funding coordination
- Add these dimensions to legacy assessment with a documented disposition per system
- Extend the four disposition options (e.g. consolidate, contain, replace in part)
- Include costs of parallel operation, migration, archival and decommissioning in the investment case
